description: 白方连续弃后，迫使黑子填满底线，车完成将杀
explanation_en: White uses a series of checks and queen sacrifices to force Black's pieces onto the back rank, then mates with a rook.

intro.popup: 💡 底线杀：黑王在f8，底线有象（d8方向）和后（c8）。白后在d1、车在e1。如何用连续将军迫使底线封死？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Back-rank mate: Black's king is on f8, with a bishop near d8 and queen on c8. White has a queen on d1 and rook on e1. How can White use repeated checks to seal the back rank?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：连续将军迫使黑象、黑后先后填满底线，最终车Rxe8#将杀——每一步将军都是为了让黑子挡死自己的退路。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: A series of checks forces Black's bishop and queen to occupy the back rank. Rxe8# finishes the mate; each check makes Black's own pieces block another escape square.

moves.popup: 白后Qxd6+！将军，同时打开e线视线。黑方只能用象挡。
moves.popup_en: Qxd6+! White checks and opens the e-file. Black can only block with the bishop.

moves.popup: 黑象到e7挡将——但这为后续的将杀铺路。
moves.popup_en: The bishop blocks on e7, but this helps set up the later mate.

moves.popup: 白后再吃象将军！黑王被迫走到g8。
moves.popup_en: The queen captures the bishop with check, forcing the black king to g8.

moves.popup: 黑王到g8——底线现在更加暴露。
moves.popup_en: The king moves to g8, making the back rank even more vulnerable.

moves.popup: 白后到e8将军！黑后必须挡在e8——底线最后一道空格被填满。
moves.popup_en: Qe8+! The black queen must block on e8, filling the last open square on the back rank.

moves.popup: 黑后被迫吃白后到e8——恰好封死了e线，白车将杀。
moves.popup_en: The black queen is forced to capture White's queen on e8, blocking the e-file and setting up the rook mate.

moves.popup: Rxe8#！白车沿e线将死黑王，底线杀完成。
moves.popup_en: Rxe8#! The rook mates along the e-file and completes the back-rank attack.
